recipe.visualDefinition: A bright, high-key portrait of a smiling female figure against a shimmering silver bokeh background, featuring bold, multi-layered, illustrative typography in the foreground.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame, balanced by heavy typography on the left.
The silver bokeh background provides a high-contrast texture against the subject's smooth skin and hair.
The vibrant colors of the clothing and text pop against the neutral, sparkling backdrop.
coreInvariants: Out-of-focus circular light artifacts (bokeh) in the background.
High-key, even studio lighting on the subject's face.
Heavy black outlines on all foreground graphic elements.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up, subject positioned slightly off-center to the right, filling the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and smile, followed by the large, stylized title text.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the subject's eyes down to the bright clothing patterns, then left to the large graphic logo.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper left and right corners consist of dense, sparkling bokeh texture.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Purple, Gold, and Teal (text and clothing patterns)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value and high saturation for accents; background is high value but low saturation.

letterConstructionRules: Internal gradients or patterns (e.g., marquee lights, metallic sheen)
Exaggerated proportions with interlocking or overlapping characters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial letters are significantly larger and serve as anchors
Numbers are rendered with 3D depth and beveling

composition.overlap: letters overlap each other and the subject

treatment.outline: multiple thick black and white strokes

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast a highly decorative, multi-colored main title with a smaller, clean sans-serif for secondary branding.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the heavy weight needed for the base skeleton.
Matches the playful, energetic entertainment vibe.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a blonde woman with bangs smiling, wearing a black tank top with colorful geometric sequined patches. The background should be a bright, shimmering silver bokeh of out-of-focus lights.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, stylized title in the bottom left using thick black outlines, purple and gold gradients, and a 3D beveled effect. Ensure the text has a slight upward diagonal tilt.

verificationChecks: Does the background consist of distinct circular light artifacts?
Is there a thick black outline around the main text?
Is the lighting on the subject bright and even?

mustAchieve: Clear visual depth between text and subject

postGenerationChecks: Check for clean edges on the text outlines.
Ensure the bokeh does not distract from the subject's face.
Verify that the 3D effect on the numbers is consistent with the text tilt.
Confirm the color of the text complements the clothing patterns.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key studio portrait + Silver bokeh background + Multi-layered 3D illustrated typography with heavy black strokes.
